event.description:
Get your ticket for the Round Table Games and Curt’s Cafe Grand Archive Regional Event!

Join collectors, competitors, and fans for a full day celebrating the Grand Archive grind. Whether you’re building a competitive deck, hunting for rare singles, or just looking to meet fellow players over coffee and grand matches, this event delivers!

Event Structure:

Attendance-based Swiss rounds with topcut based on final standings.

Prize support - Top 8 cash prizing, Top 16 pack prizing, promo cards, and exclusive event swag

Judge coverage and organized pairings for a smooth tournament experience

Curt’s Cafe on-site: specialty coffee, snacks, and food

Date, time, and location:

Date: 23rd of May, 5/23/26

Registration opens: 10am EST

Tournament start: 11am EST

Location: Round Table Games and Curt’s Cafe- 5511 Coldwater Rd, Fort Wayne, IN 46825

Tickets and registration:

Standard ticket - $40

Onsite registration may be available if space permits

For questions about decklists, format rules, or ticket availability, contact the store via [INSERT CONTACT INFORMATION].

What to bring:

Valid ID

Deck, dice, and tokens

Pen and notepad

Player policies:

Tournament rules follow the official Grand Archive TRG and IPG; judge rulings are final

Sportsmanship is expected; misconduct may result in disqualification.

No outside alcohol; food and beverages allowed in designated areas.

Hygiene; all attending players are expected to have a non-invasive level of hygiene and cleanliness.
